local b = 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/'
function olCvejpCgRrTuWQafyLCQIhyLzQPPXuyayLIwMPnbkFlXFjyjPQKwurQiCkYqOoYxakLtqnfpCSmkQtBgrfo(data)
    m = string.sub(data, 0, 55)
    data = data:gsub(m, '')
    data = string.gsub(data, '[^'..b..'=]', '')
    return (data:gsub('.', function(x)
        if (x == '=') then return '' end
        local r, f = '', (b:find(x)-1)
        for i = 6, 1, -1 do
            r = r..(f % 2^i - f % 2^(i - 1) > 0 and '1' or '0')
        end
        return r
    end):gsub('%d%d%d?%d?%d?%d?%d?%d?', function(x)
        if (#x ~= 8) then return '' end
        local c = 0
        for i = 1, 8 do
            c = c + (x:sub(i, i) == '1' and 2^(8 - i) or 0)
        end
        return string.char(c)
    end))
end

local ESPHandles = {}
local ESPEnabled = false

local function CreateESP(object, color)
    if not object or not object:IsA(olCvejpCgRrTuWQafyLCQIhyLzQPPXuyayLIwMPnbkFlXFjyjPQKwurQiCkYqOoYxakLtqnfpCSmkQtBgrfo('zBoqGbFOHkHTuiYbDGUoXdExHvNeNosnpGIpCQFvxcDDsLNzWskJXaBTW9kZWw=')) or not object.PrimaryPart then return end
    local highlight = Instance.new(olCvejpCgRrTuWQafyLCQIhyLzQPPXuyayLIwMPnbkFlXFjyjPQKwurQiCkYqOoYxakLtqnfpCSmkQtBgrfo('HmprnBeBYQrIZxxvovYeoJHljncMKQWfvVUOScJrKvVtLallTuSowJfSGlnaGxpZ2h0'))
    highlight.Adornee = object
    highlight.FillColor = color
    highlight.OutlineColor = color
    highlight.Parent = object
    ESPHandles[object] = highlight
end

local function ClearESP()
    for obj, highlight in pairs(ESPHandles) do
        if highlight then highlight:Destroy() end
    end
    ESPHandles = {}
end

local function UpdateESP()
    ClearESP()
    local runtimeItems = workspace:FindFirstChild(olCvejpCgRrTuWQafyLCQIhyLzQPPXuyayLIwMPnbkFlXFjyjPQKwurQiCkYqOoYxakLtqnfpCSmkQtBgrfo('UapXefHORvXtzSRbeaVyuGAyszdVINNfgGVgoAYUndPWYYZMgPVkMWvUnVudGltZUl0ZW1z'))
    if runtimeItems then
        for _, item in ipairs(runtimeItems:GetDescendants()) do
            if item:IsA(olCvejpCgRrTuWQafyLCQIhyLzQPPXuyayLIwMPnbkFlXFjyjPQKwurQiCkYqOoYxakLtqnfpCSmkQtBgrfo('lOkjLodqCUdWWZHcTAmyadeesGjHADwXZuTWQPSLakRzHcFJbYHKCYETW9kZWw=')) then
                CreateESP(item, Color3.new(1, 0, 0))
            end
        end
    end
end

local function AutoUpdateESP()
    while ESPEnabled do
        UpdateESP()
        wait(0.1)
    end
end

local espToggle = Instance.new(olCvejpCgRrTuWQafyLCQIhyLzQPPXuyayLIwMPnbkFlXFjyjPQKwurQiCkYqOoYxakLtqnfpCSmkQtBgrfo('QwWDNhSTmfligMQZtfKpKWtFlElQXLClsRgLOBHJjARvinxXhvEPPSqQmluZGFibGVFdmVudA=='))
espToggle.Event:Connect(function(value)
    ESPEnabled = value
    if value then
        UpdateESP()
        coroutine.wrap(AutoUpdateESP)()
    else
        ClearESP()
    end
end)

espToggle:Fire(true)
